words.tr:
v. 实施；传导（电、热）；
n. 行为；举止；
words.ex: The company will conduct a survey next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周进行一项调查。
words.en: To organize and carry out a particular activity.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.ex: He makes the most of his time to study.
words.ex_cn: 他充分利用时间学习。
words.en: To use something to its fullest potential or to take full advantage of an opportunity.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: He showed excellence in math competitions.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中表现出色。
words.en: The quality of being outstanding or extremely good.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.ex: To begin with, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: As a first point or reason; initially.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.w: make a point of doing sth.
words.tr: phrase. 特意做某事；认为做某事很重要；总是坚持做某事
words.uk: meɪk ə pɔɪnt əv ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ə pɔɪnt əv ˈduɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: She made a point of thanking everyone who helped her.
words.ex_cn: 她特意感谢了每一个帮助过她的人。
words.en: If you make a point of doing something, you do it in a very deliberate and obvious way, often because you think it is important.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: He tries to memorize the words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天试着记住这些单词。
words.en: To memorize something means to learn it so well that you can remember it perfectly.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.tr: v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；
words.ex: Plants thrive in sunny places.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光充足的地方茁壮成长。
words.en: To thrive means to grow or develop well or vigorously.

words.tr: n. 始终一贯；前后一致；
words.ex: His consistency in studying every day helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习的一贯坚持帮助他通过了考试。
words.en: Consistency is the quality or condition of being consistent, especially in achieving a level of performance or behavior that does not vary greatly in quality over time.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr: phrase. 涉及；专心； 卷入
words.ex: He is involved in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他参与了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To be included or participate in something, especially something that requires a lot of time or effort.

words.ex: He got involved in the school play last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月参加了学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To become a part of or participate in an activity or situation.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.ex: She participates in track and field events.
words.ex_cn: 她参加田径项目。
words.en: Track and field refers to a group of athletic events that involve running, jumping, and throwing. It is a major category within the sport of athletics.

words.ex: He plays rugby every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打橄榄球。
words.en: Rugby is a sport played by two teams of 15 players each, using an oval ball that players kick, pass, or carry in order to score points by grounding the ball behind the opponent's goal line or kicking it between the goalposts.

words.ex: He joined a local book association.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了一个本地的图书协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.ex: He refused to disclose the secret.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝透露这个秘密。
words.en: To disclose information means to make it known to the public.

words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.ex: The system uses colour-coded labels to indicate different types of waste.
words.ex_cn: 该系统使用有色标签来指示不同类型的废物。
words.en: Marked with different colours to make it easy to identify or categorize.

words.ex: He put the papers in a red folder.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件放进了一个红色的活页夹。
words.en: A folder is a thin piece of cardboard or plastic in which you can keep loose papers.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: He learned a new technique to paint better.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一种新的绘画技术。
words.en: A technique is a particular method of doing an activity, usually a method that involves practical skills.

words.tr:
n. 提倡者；
v. 提倡；
words.ex: He is an advocate for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 他是清洁用水的提倡者。
words.en: If you advocate a particular action or plan, you recommend it publicly.

words.ex: She completed the task effectively.
words.ex_cn: 她有效地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that produces the intended result or a successful outcome.

words.ex: The company improved data retention after upgrading its system.
words.ex_cn: 公司在升级系统后提高了数据保留能力。
words.en: The action of retaining something; the continued possession, use, or control of something.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.ex: He changed his pace to match the group.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了步伐以跟上队伍。
words.en: The speed at which someone or something moves, or with which something happens or changes.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.tr: v. 使不知所措；使无法解决；击败；压垮；淹没
words.ex: The homework overwhelms her every night.
words.ex_cn: 每天晚上的作业让她感到不堪重负。
words.en: To overwhelm means to bury or drown beneath a huge mass of something, or to defeat someone completely.

words.tr: phrase. 在手边；在附近；即将到来
words.ex: The solution is at hand.
words.ex_cn: 解决办法就在眼前。
words.en: If something is at hand, it is nearby or about to happen.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.ex: He always procrastinates doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他总是拖延做作业。
words.en: If you procrastinate, you keep leaving things you should do until later, often because you do not want to do them.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸；拆毁；记录；记下；笔录；取下
words.ex: He took down the old photo from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上的旧照片取了下来。
words.en: To write something down, especially in order to remember or record it; to remove something from a high position; to dismantle or disassemble something.

words.ex: He did revision for his math test last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚为数学考试进行了复习。
words.en: The act or process of revising; a revised or new version, as of a book or other written material.

words.ex: He quickly jot down the phone number.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙记下了电话号码。
words.en: To write or mark down quickly or briefly.

words.ex: He likes to jot down ideas in his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢把想法记在笔记本上。
words.en: To write or mark down quickly or briefly.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.tr: v. 使恢复精力；使复原；使变新
words.ex: A short nap can refresh you.
words.ex_cn: 小睡一会儿能让你恢复精力。
words.en: To refresh someone means to make them feel less tired or less hot.

words.ex: He looked at the notes to refresh his memory before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他看了看笔记，以便在考试前唤醒记忆。
words.en: To remind someone of something they have forgotten or to help someone remember something more clearly.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.ex: He lies in bed on Sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 他在周日早上睡懒觉。
words.en: To be the main or most important part of something; to stay in bed longer than usual in the morning.

words.ex: He is on the way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在去学校的路上。
words.en: In the process of going somewhere or becoming something.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: He didn't speak up when the teacher asked a question.
words.ex_cn: 老师问问题时，他没有开口。
words.en: to express one's opinions or feelings openly and without fear, especially in a situation where it might be difficult to do so

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.ex: The child's curiosity made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的好奇心让他问了很多问题。
words.en: A desire to know or learn about something; something that is interesting because it is unusual or strange.

words.ex: He explained the idea concisely.
words.ex_cn: 他简洁地解释了这个想法。
words.en: In a concise manner; briefly and clearly.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He solved the problem on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他自己解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.ex: It is a hypothetical situation.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个假设的情况。
words.en: A hypothetical situation, idea, or explanation is based on possible ideas or situations rather than actual ones.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.tr: adj. 暂定的；不确定的；试验性的；
words.ex: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们制定了一个下周见面的暂定计划。
words.en: If you make a tentative suggestion or plan, you make it without being sure that it is right or acceptable.

words.tr: v. 以…为基础；“base”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 基地 (或总部) 在…的；办公地点在…的（不用于名词前）；
words.ex: The movie is based on a true story.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影以一个真实故事为基础。
words.en: If one thing is based on another, the first thing is developed from or uses the second thing as its main idea or starting point.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: He devised a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: To devise something means to plan or invent a new way of doing something.

words.ex: The company will employ five new workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将雇佣五名新员工。
words.en: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.tr: phrase. 最后但同样重要的
words.ex: Last but not least, don't forget to bring your ID.
words.ex_cn: 最后但同样重要的是，别忘了带你的身份证。
words.en: used to say that the last person or thing mentioned is as important as the others

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.ex: His contribution helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他的贡献帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A contribution is a gift or payment to a common fund or collection, or the part played by a person or thing in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.ex: The child showed signs of talent in infancy.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在婴儿期就表现出天赋。
words.en: The earliest period of childhood, especially before the ability to walk has been acquired.

words.tr:
n. 后者（the ~）；
adj. 后期的；后面的；
words.ex: I like tea and coffee; I prefer the latter.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶和咖啡；我更喜欢后者。
words.en: The latter is used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr: phrase. 不辞辛劳地做某事；费心尽力做某事
words.ex: He takes pains to write every letter clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他努力把每个字母写得清晰。
words.en: To make a great effort to ensure that something is done well or correctly.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.tr: v. 使留下深刻印象；使铭记；
words.ex: His speech impressed everyone in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲给在场的每个人留下了深刻印象。
words.en: If someone or something impresses you, you feel great admiration for them.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: He saw an advertisement on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则广告。
words.en: An advertisement is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.tr: phrase. 就某人而言；在某人方面；由某人所做的
words.ex: The failure was not due to lack of effort on my part.
words.ex_cn: 这次失败并不是因为我这边没有努力。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is done or caused by someone.

words.ex: He speaks English fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地讲英语。
words.en: If you speak a language or read fluently, you speak or read it easily, well, and quickly.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的； v. 取得资格；“qualify”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a qualified teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有资格的老师。
words.en: Having the necessary qualifications for a particular job or task.

words.ex: It's ridiculous to think he can run a mile in one minute.
words.ex_cn: 认为他能在一分钟内跑完一英里是荒谬的。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is ridiculous, you mean that they are very foolish.

words.ex: Hurry up, or else you'll miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会错过公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce the alternative that is likely or certain to happen if something does not happen or is not done.

words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.ex: He works efficiently to finish his tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他高效地完成任务。
words.en: If you do something efficiently, you do it in a way that wastes no time, money, or energy.

words.tr: phrase. 做某事是没用的；做某事无济于事
words.ex: It's no use crying over spilt milk.
words.ex_cn: 覆水难收，哭泣无用。
words.en: It means that there is no benefit or point in doing a particular thing because it will not change the situation or achieve anything.

words.tr: v. 指出；表明；争论；争辩；
words.ex: He argued that the plan was too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他指出这个计划太昂贵了。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: He will pass the test, no doubt.
words.ex_cn: 他肯定会通过考试。
words.en: You use no doubt to indicate that you are making a judgment or statement that you think is probably true, although you are not certain.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: I agree with you to an extent, but I think there are other factors to consider.
words.ex_cn: 我在某种程度上同意你，但我认为还有其他因素需要考虑。
words.en: To a certain degree or in a certain measure; somewhat but not entirely.

words.ex: To some extent, he likes the new job.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他喜欢这份新工作。
words.en: To some extent means to a certain degree or in a certain measure, but not completely.

words.tr: 短语. 到什么程度；在多大程度上
words.ex: To what extent are you willing to go to achieve your goals?
words.ex_cn: 你愿意为了达到你的目标走多远？
words.en: used to ask how much something is true or how great an effect it has

words.ex: To a certain extent, his absence was felt by the team.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他的缺席让团队感到了影响。
words.en: To some degree; partly.

words.tr: phrase. 到如此程度；到这般地步
words.ex: She was shocked to such an extent that she couldn't speak.
words.ex_cn: 她震惊到说不出话来。
words.en: To the degree or point that is specified or implied.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: He has an advantage because he speaks two languages.
words.ex_cn: 他有优势，因为他会说两种语言。
words.en: To be in a better position or situation than someone else, especially in a competition or conflict.

words.ex: He has an advantage over others because he speaks English well.
words.ex_cn: 他因为英语说得很好而比别人有优势。
words.en: To be in a better position or have a better chance than someone else.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.tr: 短语动词. 走极端；采取极端措施
words.ex: She tends to go to extremes when dieting, either eating too much or not at all.
words.ex_cn: 她在节食时往往走极端，要么吃得太多，要么一点也不吃。
words.en: To act or be forced to act in a way that is far from moderate or normal, often to achieve a goal or express an opinion.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.ex: He gave a precise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了准确的答案。
words.en: If you give precise information or precise instructions, you give exact details so that there is no confusion about what should be done.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.ex: I like her, and vice versa.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢她，她也喜欢我。
words.en: Used to indicate that the reverse of what you have said is also true.

words.ex: The translation of the book took two months.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的翻译花了两个月。
words.en: The process of translating words or text from one language into another.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.tr: phrase. 向某人提供；供给某人某物
words.ex: The company provided the employees with all necessary equipment.
words.ex_cn: 公司为员工提供了所有必要的设备。
words.en: To supply or make available to someone something that is needed or wanted.

words.ex: He can't even walk, let alone run.
words.ex_cn: 他连走都走不了，更别说跑了。
words.en: Used to emphasize the improbability of a contrasting example.

words.ex: His intonation made the sentence sound friendly.
words.ex_cn: 他的语调让这句话听起来很友好。
words.en: Intonation is the way the voice rises and falls in speech, especially the pitch pattern in a sentence.

words.ex: The behaviorist studies how animals learn from rewards.
words.ex_cn: 行为主义者研究动物如何从奖励中学习。
words.en: A behaviorist is someone who believes in or practices behaviorism, a theory that suggests that all behaviors are acquired through conditioning.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.tr: phrase. 喜欢做某事；爱好做某事
words.ex: She is fond of reading novels.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢读小说。
words.en: To like or enjoy doing something.

words.ex: He continually checks his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地查看手机。
words.en: If something happens continually, it happens without stopping or happening repeatedly over a period of time.

words.ex: The parrot can say hello.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹦鹉会说你好。
words.en: A parrot is a tropical bird with a curved beak and brightly colored feathers. Parrots are often kept as pets because they can be taught to copy human speech.

words.ex: The chimpanzee is eating a banana.
words.ex_cn: 这只黑猩猩正在吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A chimpanzee is a great ape native to the forest and savannah of tropical Africa. It is known for its intelligence, use of tools, and complex social structures.

words.ex: The theorist wrote a simple book about stars.
words.ex_cn: 这位理论家写了一本关于恒星的简单书籍。
words.en: A theorist is someone who develops or studies theories, especially in science or philosophy.

words.ex: In my opinion, the movie is very good.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这部电影非常好。
words.en: Used to express someone's personal view or belief about something.

words.ex: Unlike his brother, he likes quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 不像他的兄弟，他喜欢安静的地方。
words.en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things are different in nature or in appearance.

words.tr: v. 有关；把…联系起来；认同；叙述；理解；
words.ex: This story relates to your childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与你的童年有关。
words.en: If you relate a story, you tell it. If two things relate, they are connected in some way.

words.tr: 短语. 值得某物；具有某种价值
words.ex: This book is worth reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: To have a particular value, especially in money, or to be important or useful enough to justify a particular action or effort.

words.ex: It is worth taking the time to read this book.
words.ex_cn: 花时间读这本书是值得的。
words.en: If something is worth doing, it is important or useful, and you should do it.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Good communication helps people understand each other.
words.ex_cn: 良好的交流有助于人们相互理解。
words.en: The imparting or exchanging of information by speaking, writing, or using some other medium.

words.tr: phrase. 类似于； 与 ... 相似
words.ex: This apple is similar to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: The pine grows tall in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 松树在森林里长得很高。
words.en: A pine is a type of evergreen tree which has long thin leaves called needles and produces cones. As a verb, to pine means to feel a deep longing or desire for something or someone.

words.tr: n. 收集；采集；聚会；聚集； v. 聚集；集合；“gather”的现在分词；
words.ex: The gathering of old books took him years.
words.ex_cn: 收集旧书花了他多年时间。
words.en: A gathering is a group of people meeting together for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.tr: n. 正式舞会，毕业舞会
words.ex: He wore a suit to the prom.
words.ex_cn: 他穿西装去参加毕业舞会。
words.en: A prom is a formal dance held for a high school or college class, typically at the end of the academic year.

words.ex: The accident occurred yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.ex: The caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成了一只蝴蝶。
words.en: To change or develop into something different.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.tr:
v. 修剪；扫杀
n. 麦秆堆；干草堆积处
words.ex: He mows the lawn every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六都割草。
words.en: To cut down (grass or grain) with a scythe or a machine.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人措手不及；出其不意地袭击或惊吓某人
words.ex: His sudden resignation took everyone by surprise.
words.ex_cn: 他突然辞职让所有人都大吃一惊。
words.en: To cause someone to feel surprise because they were not expecting something.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人措手不及；出其不意地袭击或影响某人
words.ex: The sudden noise caught him by surprise.
words.ex_cn: 突如其来的噪音让他大吃一惊。
words.en: To catch someone by surprise means to do something that they are not expecting and that surprises them.

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.ex: He raised his eyebrow when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个消息时抬起了眉毛。
words.en: An eyebrow is the line of hair that grows above your eye.

words.ex: The police opened an inquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An inquiry is a question which you ask in order to get some information.

words.tr: adj. 引起烦恼的；令人不安的； v. 打扰；妨碍；“disturb”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie showed a disturbing scene of violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个引起烦恼的暴力场景。
words.en: If you describe something as disturbing, you mean that it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.ex: The wind turns the blade of the fan.
words.ex_cn: 风转动了风扇的叶片。
words.en: The flat cutting part of a tool or weapon, such as a knife or sword.

words.tr:
n. 碎片；细条；少量
v. 撕碎；切碎
words.ex: The dog found a shred of paper in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗在院子里找到一片纸屑。
words.en: A shred is a very small amount of something, especially a very small piece of paper or cloth. When you shred something, you cut it or tear it into very small pieces.

words.ex: He bit his fingernail when he was nervous.
words.ex_cn: 他紧张时会咬指甲。
words.en: Your fingernails are the thin hard areas at the end of each of your fingers.

words.ex: I acquaint him with the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 我让他熟悉新规则。
words.en: If you acquaint someone with something, you tell them about it so that they know it.

words.ex: He is acquainted with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are acquainted with something, you know about it or are familiar with it.

words.tr: phrase. 开始了解；熟悉；与……相识
words.ex: It takes time to become acquainted with a new city.
words.ex_cn: v. 熟悉一个新城市需要时间。
words.en: To become familiar or knowledgeable about someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 熟悉某事；了解某事
words.ex: I am acquainted with the new software.
words.ex_cn: 我熟悉这款新软件。
words.en: To be familiar with or know something, especially because you have learned about it or experienced it.

words.tr: phrase. 开始了解某事；熟悉某事物
words.ex: It took me several weeks to become acquainted with the new software.
words.ex_cn: v. 我花了几周时间才熟悉了新软件。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.tr: 短语动词，心里想着……；惦记着……
words.ex: I have my exam on my mind.
words.ex_cn: 我脑子里一直想着我的考试。
words.en: To be thinking about or worrying about something.

words.tr: phrase. 集中思绪；整理思路；静下心来思考
words.ex: Before speaking, he took a moment to gather his thoughts.
words.ex_cn: 在说话之前，他花了一点时间整理自己的思绪。
words.en: To take time to think clearly and calmly, especially after a period of confusion or stress.

words.tr:
v. 咯咯地叫；大声抱怨
n. 刺耳的叫声；大声抱怨
words.ex: The parrot squawked loudly when it saw the visitor.
words.ex_cn: 鹦鹉看到访客时咯咯地叫了起来。
words.en: To squawk means to make a loud, harsh noise, often used to describe the sound made by birds. It can also mean to complain loudly or protest about something.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.ex: He felt awkward when he forgot his friend's name.
words.ex_cn: 当他忘记朋友的名字时，他感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you describe a situation as awkward, you mean that it is embarrassing or difficult to deal with.

words.tr: adv. 惊人地；令人担忧地
words.ex: The air is alarmingly polluted.
words.ex_cn: 空气污染得令人担忧。
words.en: In a way that causes worry or fear; surprisingly or shockingly.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人隐瞒某事；不让某人知道某事
words.ex: She tried to keep the bad news from him, but he eventually found out.
words.ex_cn: 她试图对他隐瞒这个坏消息，但他最终还是发现了。
words.en: To prevent someone from knowing something.

words.ex: You have three options to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 你有三个选项可以选择。
words.en: An option is something that you can choose to do in preference to one or more alternatives.

words.ex: The table is made of sturdy wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用坚固的木头做的。
words.en: Someone or something that is sturdy looks strong and is unlikely to be easily injured or damaged.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: Graduating with honors was her greatest accomplishment.
words.ex_cn: 以优异成绩毕业是她最大的成就。
words.en: Something that has been achieved successfully.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.tr: phrase. 支吾其词；犹豫不决地说话
words.ex: He started to hem and haw when the teacher asked him the answer.
words.ex_cn: 当老师问他答案时，他支支吾吾起来。
words.en: To hem and haw means to hesitate in speaking or to speak evasively, often because one is unsure or unwilling to commit to a particular statement or decision.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.tr:
n. 浸泡；
v. 吸收；
words.ex: The clothes went into a soak overnight.
words.ex_cn: 衣服泡了一整晚。
words.en: To soak something means to make it very wet by leaving it in a liquid, or to become very wet in this way. It can also mean to absorb or take in something.

words.ex: The sponge soaks up water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸水。
words.en: To absorb or take in (a liquid, knowledge, or experience) fully.

words.tr: 短语动词. 回到原点；完成一个循环；情况经过一系列变化后又恢复到最初的状态
words.ex: After years of traveling, he has come full circle and returned to his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的旅行，他兜了一圈又回到了家乡。
words.en: To return to the original position or state after a series of events or changes.

words.tr: 短语动词. 回到原点；重拾旧方式；经历一个完整的循环后回到起点
words.ex: After years of changes, the fashion trend has gone full circle.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的变迁，时尚潮流又回到了原点。
words.en: To return to the original position or state after a series of events or changes.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.tr:
v. 摇摆；摇动；
n. 影响；支配；
words.ex: The tree branches sway in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树的枝条在风中摇摆。
words.en: To sway means to move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side. It can also mean to influence someone or something.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.tr:
n. 婴儿；
adj. 初期的；
words.ex: The infant is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: An infant is a baby or very young child.

words.tr: adj. 说话温和的；善于言辞的
words.ex: She was a soft-spoken woman with a gentle demeanor.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位说话温和、举止文雅的女士。
words.en: If someone is soft-spoken, they speak quietly and gently.

words.tr: phrase. 适应某事物；安顿下来进入某种状态或环境
words.ex: It took her a few weeks to settle into her new job.
words.ex_cn: 她花了几个星期才适应新工作。
words.en: To become comfortable in a new place or situation; to start to feel at home somewhere or to become used to a new job or activity.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.tr: phrase. 任何类似的东西；像……一样的任何事物
words.ex: I don't like this book, and I don't like anything like it.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这本书，也不喜欢任何类似的东西。
words.en: Similar to or resembling something in a particular way; often used in negative or interrogative contexts.

words.ex: The satellite beams signals to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星向地球发射信号。
words.en: A beam is a long, thick piece of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof of a building. It can also refer to a line of light that shines from a bright object, or a smile that shows someone is very happy.

words.ex: He stood in the midst of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他站在人群中间。
words.en: The middle part or point of something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……之中；在……当中；正当……的时候
words.ex: He is running in the midst of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在人群中奔跑。
words.en: If you are in the midst of doing something, you are doing it at the moment.

words.tr: adj. 光荣的；可敬的；尊敬的
words.ex: He is an honorable man who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是说真话的正直的人。
words.en: Deserving respect and admiration; having high moral standards.

words.ex: He is an honourable man who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位正直可敬的人，总是说真话。
words.en: If you describe people or actions as honourable, you mean that they are good and deserve to be respected and admired.

words.ex: He is an industrious student who studies every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个勤勉的学生，每天都学习。
words.en: Someone who is industrious works hard and is determined.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；叹息
n. 呻吟声；叹息声
words.ex: He groaned when he saw the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那个沉重的箱子时呻吟了一声。
words.en: If you groan, you make a long, low sound because you are in pain, or because you are upset or unhappy about something.

words.tr:
v. 称赞；恭维
n. 称赞；恭维
words.ex: He gave her a compliment on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 他夸了她的裙子。
words.en: A compliment is a polite expression of praise or admiration.

words.tr: phrase. 与……相适应；与……协调；融入
words.ex: He tried to fit in with the new group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新团体。
words.en: To be accepted by or to belong to a particular group or to be in harmony with something.

words.tr: adv. 强调地；断然地；显然地
words.ex: She emphatically denied the accusation.
words.ex_cn: 她坚决否认了这项指控。
words.en: In a forceful way that shows emphasis.

words.ex: The rebellion against the king failed.
words.ex_cn: 反对国王的叛乱失败了。
words.en: A rebellion is an organized attempt to overthrow a government or authority by a group of people.

words.ex: He is stubborn and won't change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很顽固，不肯改变主意。
words.en: Someone who is stubborn is determined to do what they want and is very unwilling to change their mind.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: He remembers his childhood as a happy time.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的童年是一段快乐的时光。
words.en: Childhood is the period of a person's life when they are a child.

words.ex: He compares his score with his friend's score.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的分数和朋友的分数做比较。
words.en: To examine or look for the difference between two or more things.

words.tr:
v. 皱眉；蹙额
n. 皱眉；蹙额
words.ex: He frowns when he hears bad news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到坏消息时会皱眉。
words.en: If you frown, you bring your eyebrows together so that there are lines on your face above your eyes, often because you are annoyed or worried.

words.tr: phrase. 会付出很多；愿意给予大量（常指时间、努力或情感）
words.ex: He would give a lot to see his family again.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意付出很多来再见到他的家人。
words.en: To be willing to make a significant effort or sacrifice.

words.tr: phrase. 愿意付出任何代价；非常渴望（得到某物或做某事）
words.ex: She would give anything to see him again.
words.ex_cn: 她愿意付出一切再次见到他。
words.en: If you say that you would give anything or do anything to have or achieve something, you are emphasizing how much you want it.

words.tr: phrase. 愿意付出一切；甘愿奉献全世界（常用于表达强烈愿望或牺牲精神）
words.ex: She would give the world to see him again.
words.ex_cn: 她非常想再见到他。
words.en: To be willing to do anything to achieve something desired.

words.w: would give a lot to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 非常愿意付出很大代价去做某事；极想做某事
words.uk: /wʊd ɡɪv ə lɒt tuː duː sʌmθɪŋ/
words.us: /wʊd ɡɪv ə lɑːt tuː duː sʌmθɪŋ/
words.ex: She would give a lot to do sth. like going on a vacation right now.
words.ex_cn: 她现在非常想去度假。
words.en: To be willing to make a significant sacrifice or effort to achieve or obtain something.

words.w: would give anything to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 愿意付出任何代价去做某事；极渴望做某事
words.ex: She would give anything to see her son again.
words.ex_cn: 她愿意付出一切再次见到她的儿子。
words.en: To be willing to do or give whatever is necessary to achieve something or to have something happen.

words.w: would give the world to do sth.
words.tr: phrase. 愿意付出一切代价去做某事；极渴望做某事
words.uk: wʊd ɡɪv ðə wɜːld tə duː sʌmθɪŋ
words.us: wʊd ɡɪv ðə wɜrld tə duː sʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He would give the world to be with her right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在非常想和她在一起。
words.en: If you say that you would give the world or would give anything to do something, you are emphasizing that you would very much like to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 凭自身的能力或资格；独立地；本身
words.ex: She is a successful artist in her own right.
words.ex_cn: 她本身就是一个成功的艺术家。
words.en: If someone is a particular kind of person in their own right, they are that kind of person because of their own efforts, talents, or qualities, and not because of their connection with someone else.

words.ex: The topic of our talk is climate change.
words.ex_cn: 我们谈话的话题是气候变化。
words.en: A topic is a particular subject that you discuss or write about.

words.ex: The glare of the sun made it hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的刺眼使我看不清。
words.en: If you glare at someone, you look at them with an angry expression on your face. Glare is also a very bright light that is uncomfortable to look at.

words.ex: I am sick of cold rain every day.
words.ex_cn: 我厌倦了每天下冷雨。
words.en: To be tired of or bored with something or someone.

words.ex: The frog hopped over the stone.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙跃过了那块石头。
words.en: To move by jumping on one foot or to move quickly and lightly from one place to another.

words.tr:
v. 品味；细品；享用；体会
n. 风味；滋味
words.ex: He savord the taste of the chocolate slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地品味着巧克力的味道。
words.en: To enjoy or appreciate (something) completely.

words.ex: He likes to wander in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you wander in a place, you walk around there in a casual way, often without intending to go in any particular direction or to any particular place.

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.tr: phrase. 转眼间；不知不觉就；很快就会
words.ex: Before one knows it, the semester has passed by.
words.ex_cn: 很快地，一个学期就过去了。
words.en: If you say that something happens before you know it, you are emphasizing that it happens very quickly and suddenly.

words.ex: He called his friend an idiot after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他在犯错后称朋友是白痴。
words.en: An idiot is a person who is considered to be very stupid or foolish.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

words.ex: The scandal caused a dent in his reputation.
words.ex_cn: 这场丑闻削弱了他的声誉。
words.en: A dent is a hollow or depression in a surface, often caused by a blow or pressure.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们抗议新的校规。
words.en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

words.ex: The smoke made him choke.
words.ex_cn: 烟让他窒息。
words.en: If you choke, or if something chokes you, you cannot breathe properly because there is not enough air or because something is blocking your throat.

words.tr: phrase. 忍住（眼泪、情绪等）；抑制
words.ex: She tried to choke back her tears as she said goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 她在道别时试图抑制住泪水。
words.en: If you choke back tears or a feeling, you force yourself not to show your emotion.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr:
n. 恐慌；
v. 感到恐慌；
words.ex: A panic spread through the crowd when the fire alarm rang.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了恐慌。
words.en: Panic is a very strong feeling of anxiety or fear, which makes you act without thinking carefully.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.tr:
n. 击球员；
v. 连续猛击；
words.ex: The batter hit a home run in the ninth inning.
words.ex_cn: 击球员在第九局击出了全垒打。
words.en: To batter something means to hit it hard many times, often causing a lot of damage. In sports, a batter is the player who is trying to hit the ball in games like baseball or cricket. Batter can also refer to a mixture of flour, eggs, and milk or water, used to make pancakes or to coat food before frying.

words.tr:
v. 缓慢或吃力地走
n. 长途跋涉
words.ex: He trudges through the snow every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跋涉穿过雪地。
words.en: To walk slowly and with heavy steps, typically because of exhaustion or harsh conditions.

words.tr: phrase. v. 抬头挺胸；昂首；自豪地面对
words.ex: After passing the test, he can hold his head up again.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试后，他可以重新昂首挺胸了。
words.en: To maintain one's dignity or self-respect in the face of difficulties or criticism.

words.tr: n. 一个特殊日子的前夕或前夜
words.ex: The eve of Christmas is very special.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞节前夜非常特别。
words.en: The period of time immediately before an event or occasion, especially the day before a holiday or festival.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.ex: He rarely eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: Not often; seldom.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: Can you sum up the total cost?
words.ex_cn: 你能合计一下总费用吗？
words.en: If you sum something up, you briefly describe the main features or ideas of it.

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.tr: adj. 外向的；即将离职的；往外去的；
words.ex: He is an outgoing boy who loves talking to new people.
words.ex_cn: 他是个外向的男孩，喜欢和新朋友聊天。
words.en: Someone who is outgoing is very friendly and likes meeting and talking to people.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: He composes music in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间创作音乐。
words.en: To compose something means to make it by combining parts or elements.

words.ex: The team is composed of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: If something is composed of particular things, people, or elements, it is made from those things, people, or elements.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.ex: He fell into the river by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心掉进了河里。
words.en: To fall into something means to be classified or divided into it, or to start to be in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.ex: He felt deep sorrow when his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗去世时，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Sorrow is a feeling of deep sadness or regret.

words.ex: He became reflective after reading the old letter.
words.ex_cn: 他读完那封旧信后变得沉思起来。
words.en: If you are reflective, you are thinking deeply about something.

words.tr: phrase. 举办一个派对；举行聚会
words.ex: They decided to throw a party to celebrate their anniversary.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定举办一个派对来庆祝他们的周年纪念。
words.en: To organize and host a party or celebration.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事保密；不告诉别人；独自保留
words.ex: He kept the secret to himself.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏在心里。
words.en: To not tell anyone else about something.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.tr:
v. 处理；操纵；
n. 把手；柄；
words.ex: He can handle difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理难题。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.ex: The weather shows a lot of variation in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天天气变化很大。
words.en: A variation is a difference or change in the usual or expected amount, level, or form of something.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: He is a sociable man who likes to talk with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢和朋友聊天的外向的人。
words.en: A sociable person is friendly and enjoys being with other people.

words.ex: Honesty is a good trait.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种好的特性。
words.en: A trait is a particular characteristic, quality, or tendency that someone or something has.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.ex: His humor makes everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默让大家都笑了。
words.en: The quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech.

words.tr: adj. 有趣的；使人愉快的； v. 款待；“entertain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an entertaining show.
words.ex_cn: 小丑表演了一场有趣的节目。
words.en: Providing amusement or enjoyment.

words.ex: He is at work right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在工作。
words.en: If someone is at work, they are doing their job or are busy doing a particular activity.

words.ex: Heredity determines eye color in humans.
words.ex_cn: 遗传决定人类的眼睛颜色。
words.en: Heredity is the process by which features and characteristics are passed on from parents to their children before the children are born.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.ex: He inherited a house from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.en: If you inherit something such as a trait, characteristic, or quality, you are born with it, because your parents or ancestors had it. If you inherit money or property, you receive it from someone who has died.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: There is a resemblance between the two brothers.
words.ex_cn: 这两兄弟之间有相似之处。
words.en: If there is a resemblance between two people or things, they are similar to each other.

words.ex: He is evidently tired after the long walk.
words.ex_cn: 他走完漫长的路后显然很累。
words.en: In a way that is clearly seen or understood; obviously.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.ex: The trees surround the house.
words.ex_cn: 树木环绕着房子。
words.en: If something or someone is surrounded by something, that thing is situated all around them.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr: phrase. 对…有影响；对…起作用；产生效果
words.ex: Smoking has an impact on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有影响。
words.en: To have a significant effect on someone or something.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.ex: Smoking is harmful to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is harmful has a bad effect on something else, especially on a person's health.

words.ex: He exerted pressure on his team to win.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的团队施加了压力以赢得比赛。
words.en: To exert means to use power, influence, or effort to make something happen.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；令人厌倦的； v. “bore”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as boring, you mean that they are not interesting and make you feel tired or impatient.

words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.tr: adj. 满意的；满足的； v. 使满意；使满足；“satisfy”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was satisfied with the result.
words.ex_cn: 他对结果感到满意。
words.en: If you are satisfied with something, you are happy because you have got what you wanted or needed.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: He made an adjustment to live in the new city.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了适应以适应新城市的生活。
words.en: An adjustment is a small change that is made to something such as a machine or a way of doing something.

words.ex: He was shy during his adolescence.
words.ex_cn: 他在青春期时很害羞。
words.en: Adolescence is the period in a person's life when they develop from a child into an adult.

words.tr: phrase. 与...在一起；沿着；除此之外，还…
words.ex: He bought apples along with oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果，还买了橙子。
words.en: in addition to someone or something else; together with someone or something else

words.tr: v. 决心；决定；“determine”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 坚决的；坚定的；有决心的；
words.ex: He is determined to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他决心完成比赛。
words.en: If you are determined to do something, you have made a firm decision to do it and will not let anything stop you.

words.ex: He wears sunglasses on sunny days.
words.ex_cn: 他在晴天戴太阳镜。
words.en: Sunglasses are glasses with dark lenses which you wear to protect your eyes from bright sunlight.

words.ex: She smiled contentedly after eating her favorite meal.
words.ex_cn: 她吃完最爱的饭菜后满足地笑了。
words.en: In a manner that shows happiness or satisfaction.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: He flung his hat on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他把帽子扔在椅子上。
words.en: To throw something quickly and carelessly; to move or do something suddenly and energetically.

words.ex: The children were playing in the sandbox.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在沙箱里玩耍。
words.en: A sandbox is a play area for children that contains sand, often shaped into a box. In computing, a sandbox is a testing environment that isolates untested code changes and outright experimentation from the production environment or repository.

words.ex: The faint light from the candle barely lit the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛微弱的光几乎照不亮房间。
words.en: If you feel faint, you feel weak and as if you are about to lose consciousness. Something that is faint is not strong or clear.

words.tr:
v. 把…塞进狭窄的空间；把…藏入
n. 褶皱；零食
words.ex: He tucked the letter into his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把信塞进了口袋里。
words.en: If you tuck something somewhere, you put it there so that it is safe, comfortable, or neat.

words.tr: phrase. 把…收起来；藏起；偷偷吃掉（尤指食物）
words.ex: He likes to tuck away his money in a small box under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢把钱藏在床下的一个小盒子里。
words.en: To put something in a safe or hidden place, or to eat a lot of food.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎；差一点；除…外其余都
words.ex: He is all but finished with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎已经做完了作业。
words.en: All but means almost or nearly. It is used to indicate that something is very close to being the case but not completely so.

words.tr: adj. 废弃的；荒芜的；被遗弃的； v. “desert”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The deserted house had broken windows and overgrown grass.
words.ex_cn: 那座废弃的房子有破碎的窗户和茂盛的杂草。
words.en: If a place is deserted, there are no people in it.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.ex: The children played on the seesaw at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩跷跷板。
words.en: A seesaw is a long board which is balanced on a fixed part in the middle so that when one end goes up, the other goes down. It is used especially by children to play on.

words.ex: The cat sat motionless by the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫静静地坐在窗边。
words.en: If someone or something is motionless, they are not moving at all.

words.tr: v. 遗弃；抛弃；“abandon”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被遗弃了的；
words.ex: They abandoned the old car by the road.
words.ex_cn: 他们把那辆旧车遗弃在路边。
words.en: Left behind or deserted; given up.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.tr:
v. 蹲；蹲坐；擅自占住
n. 蹲；偷住的房子；蹲坐
adj. 矮而宽的；矮胖的
words.ex: He does a squat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做深蹲。
words.en: If you squat, you lower yourself towards the ground, balancing on your feet with your legs bent.

words.ex: She worked diligently to complete the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 她勤奋地工作，按时完成了项目。
words.en: In a way that shows care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties.

words.ex: The two boys sat side by side on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 两个男孩并排坐在长凳上。
words.en: If two or more things are side by side, they are next to each other.

words.tr: phrase. 一种幸福的感觉；安康感；舒适愉快的状态
words.ex: Exercising regularly can contribute to a sense of well-being.
words.ex_cn: 定期锻炼有助于增强幸福感。
words.en: A feeling of happiness and satisfaction with one's life.

words.tr: phrase. 一种幸福安康的感觉；舒适愉快的状态
words.ex: She experienced a feeling of well-being after her morning yoga session.
words.ex_cn: 她在早上的瑜伽课后感受到了一种健康和幸福的感觉。
words.en: A sense of happiness, health, and contentment.

words.tr:
n. 笼子；栏舍
v. 把…关起来
words.ex: The chickens live in a small coop.
words.ex_cn: 鸡住在小笼子里。
words.en: A coop is a cage or small building in which chickens are kept.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 把…关起来；限制某人活动（尤指长时间待在室内）
words.ex: They had to coop up the chickens in the small shed.
words.ex_cn: 他们不得不把鸡关在小棚子里。
words.en: To confine or restrict someone or something in a small space.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.tr: adv. 充满深情地；亲切地
words.ex: She smiled affectionately at her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她亲切地对弟弟笑了笑。
words.en: In a way that displays fondness or tenderness.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.ex: The train went through a long tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过了一条长长的隧道。
words.en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under or through the ground, usually through a hill or under a river, to allow people or vehicles to travel through it.

words.tr:
adj. 深思熟虑的；故意的；
v. 深思熟虑；
words.ex: He made a deliberate choice to quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 他深思熟虑后决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you do something that is deliberate, you planned or decided to do it beforehand, and so it happens on purpose rather than by chance.

words.ex: The chubby baby laughed loudly.
words.ex_cn: 那个胖乎乎的宝宝大声笑了。
words.en: Someone who is chubby is slightly fat in a way that people often find attractive.

words.ex: He dug a hole with a spade.
words.ex_cn: 他用铁锹挖了一个洞。
words.en: A spade is a tool used for digging, with a sharp-edged, typically rectangular metal blade and a long handle. In card games, a spade is one of the four suits, represented by a black symbol resembling a pointed leaf with a short stem.

words.ex: He dug a spadeful of earth from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里挖了一铲子土。
words.en: The amount that a spade can hold.

words.tr: phrase. 一铲子的（某物）；表示用铲子挖起或装载的一满铲量
words.ex: He took a spadeful of soil from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里铲了一铲土。
words.en: The amount that a spade can hold.

words.tr:
n. 铲；铁锹
v. 铲；铲起
words.ex: He uses a shovel to dig the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子挖花园。
words.en: A shovel is a tool with a long handle and a broad blade or scoop, used for moving material such as earth, snow, or coal.

words.tr: adj. 不动声色的；无动于衷的；不易激动的
words.ex: He remained stolid in the face of adversity.
words.ex_cn: 面对逆境，他依然冷漠。
words.en: If you describe someone as stolid, you mean that they do not show much emotion or are not very exciting or interesting.

words.ex: He remained impassive when he heard the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个坏消息时，他依然面无表情。
words.en: If someone is impassive, they do not show any emotion.

words.tr: adj. 不眨眼的，坚定的，不动摇的
words.ex: She stared at him with unblinking eyes.
words.ex_cn: 她用坚定的目光盯着他。
words.en: If you describe someone's eyes or expression as unblinking, you mean that they are looking steadily at something without blinking.

words.ex: He has high expectancy for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来有很高的预期。
words.en: The feeling of excitement about something that is going to happen.

words.tr: n. 哈士奇；爱斯基摩狗；
words.ex: My dog is a husky with blue eyes.
words.ex_cn: 我的狗是一只蓝色眼睛的哈士奇。
words.en: If someone's voice is husky, it is low and rough, often in an attractive way, or because of illness. A husky is also a type of dog that is used to pull sledges in cold countries.

words.ex: She put on her roller skates and started gliding across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 她穿上四轮滑冰鞋，开始在地板上滑行。
words.en: Roller skates are shoes with four small wheels on the bottom, which you wear in order to move along quickly and smoothly on a hard surface.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr:
n. 连环漫画；
adj. 滑稽的；
words.ex: He reads a comic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读一本连环漫画。
words.en: A comic is someone who entertains people by making them laugh, especially a professional comedian.

words.tr:
v. 喷吐；吐痰；吐口水
n. 唾沫；一块陆地；烤肉叉
words.ex: He likes to spit watermelon seeds.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吐西瓜籽。
words.en: To spit means to force out the contents of the mouth, especially saliva, through the lips. It can also refer to the act of ejecting saliva or phlegm from the mouth, often as a gesture of contempt or disrespect.

words.ex: She deftly solved the puzzle in minutes.
words.ex_cn: 她灵巧地在几分钟内解开了这个谜题。
words.en: In a manner that is neatly skillful and quick in movement or action.

words.ex: He ran swiftly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: If something is done swiftly, it is done quickly and without delay.

words.tr: adj. 暂定的；不确定的；试验性的；
words.ex: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们制定了一个下周见面的暂定计划。
words.en: If you make a tentative suggestion or plan, you make it without being sure that it is right or acceptable.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.ex: He is aware of the danger.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到危险。
words.en: If you are aware of something, you know about it.

words.ex: The caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶。
words.en: To begin to be something or to develop into something.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.tr: adj. 道歉的；谢罪的；愧疚的
words.ex: He gave an apologetic smile after bumping into her.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到她后露出了歉意的微笑。
words.en: If you are apologetic, you show or say that you are sorry for having caused someone trouble or unhappiness.

words.ex: The judge considered the reasonableness of the defendant's actions.
words.ex_cn: 法官考虑了被告行为的合理性。
words.en: The quality of being based on good sense or sound judgment; fairness.

words.tr: adj. 较低的；下游的；“low”的比较级； v. 降低；
words.ex: He sat in the lower row of the theater.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在剧院的较低一排。
words.en: If you lower something, you move it slowly downwards. If you lower something, you make it less in amount, degree, value, or quality.

words.tr: adj. 傲慢的；无礼的；侮慢的
words.ex: The insolent boy talked back to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 那个无礼的男孩顶撞了老师。
words.en: If you say that someone is insolent, you mean they are rude and do not show respect for people in positions of authority.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.ex: The broken bridge is a menace to drivers.
words.ex_cn: 这座破桥对司机来说是个危险物。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a menace, you mean that they are likely to cause serious harm.

words.ex: I feel like eating pizza tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚想吃披萨。
words.en: To have a desire or inclination for something; to have a sensation or impression of being a certain way.

words.tr: phrase. 想要做某事；有做某事的欲望
words.ex: I feel like eating pizza today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天想吃披萨。
words.en: To have a desire or inclination to do something.

words.tr:
n. 暴躁脾气；情绪；心情；性情
v. 使…缓和；冲淡
words.ex: He loses his temper when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会发脾气。
words.en: If you refer to someone's temper or say that they have a temper, you mean that they become angry very easily.

words.ex: He loses his temper when he hears loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他听到吵闹声时就会发脾气。
words.en: To lose one's temper means to suddenly become very angry.

words.tr: v. 弥漫于；充满；扩散；布满
words.ex: The sunset suffuses the sky with orange light.
words.ex_cn: 日落将天空染成橙色。
words.en: If something such as a colour, emotion, or light suffuses a person or thing, it gradually spreads over or through them.

words.tr: n. 温柔；柔情；压痛；柔和
words.ex: Her tenderness made the child feel safe.
words.ex_cn: 她的温柔让孩子感到安全。
words.en: The quality of being kind, gentle, and affectionate.

words.tr: adj. 无力的；虚弱的；阳痿的
words.ex: He felt impotent after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到无能为力。
words.en: If someone feels impotent, they feel that they have no power to influence people or events.

words.ex: He burst into rage when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他勃然大怒。
words.en: Rage is a feeling of intense anger that is difficult to control.

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.tr: adj. 令人厌恶的；令人憎恶的；令人不悦的
words.ex: The taste of medicine is distasteful.
words.ex_cn: 药的味道很难吃。
words.en: If something is distasteful to you, you think it is unpleasant, disgusting, or immoral.

words.tr: phrase. 稍等一下；请稍等；马上就好
words.ex: Just a minute, I am coming.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就来。
words.en: A phrase used to ask someone to wait for a short period of time.

words.tr: adv. 有礼貌地；毕恭毕敬地；恭谦地
words.ex: He spoke courteously to the old man.
words.ex_cn: 他礼貌地对那位老人说话。
words.en: In a polite, respectful, or considerate manner.

words.tr: phrase. 关闭；住口；关严；监禁；封藏
words.ex: Shut up, please, I'm trying to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 闭嘴，求你了，我在睡觉。
words.en: If you tell someone to shut up, you are rudely telling them to stop talking.

words.ex: He flexed his arm to show his muscle.
words.ex_cn: 他弯曲手臂展示他的肌肉。
words.en: To bend something, especially a part of your body, or to become bent.

words.ex: The movie shows too much violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了太多的暴力。
